name: llama.cpp+ZenDNN EPYC 9755 128c: Qwen3.5-4B prefill tok/s (512in/128seq)
methodology: VENDOR MEASURED (AMD dev blog ZD-066/067, Aug 18 2026). AMD EPYC 9755 128c single socket (one NUMA node, SMT off, 4.06GHz, DDR5-6400 12ch); llama.cpp b9326 + ZenDNN 5.2.2 (-DGGML_ZENDNN=ON), ZENDNNL_MATMUL_ALGO=AOCL-DLP, llama-batched-bench 512in/128out/128seq, flash-attn, KV=model prec, 3-run mean. Qwen3.5-4B: ZenDNN 2307.04 vs native 1209.53 tok/s. Aggregate/128seq.
notes: Native 1209.53 -> ZenDNN 2307.04 tok/s (1.91x). Decode falls back to CPU on ZenDNN 5.2.2.
